metadata.title: A Runaway Red Supergiant in M31

notes: No star meets the stated Galactic-unbound criterion. The paper's central object, J004330.06+405258.4, is an M31 runaway; its escape discussion concerns M31's disk and does not establish unbinding from the Milky Way (T:p7-b3). The statement that it "may be a high-mass analog of the hyper-velocity stars" is a conditional analogy, not an explicit Galactic-unbound identification (T:p1-b5). Other named objects are comparison/runaway stars or lack explicit unbound claims.
